description: MeteoCoast-EC provides hourly meteorological records from three Universidad Técnica de Manabí stations at Santa Ana, Portoviejo and Calderón in coastal Ecuador. The Data in Brief article states 62,815 hourly records between January 2022 and May 2026. Mendeley version 5 exposes raw and processed CSVs, station coordinates, quality flags, a data dictionary and cleaning or ETL scripts under CC BY 4.0. The station archive includes variables relevant to heat, rainfall and wind analysis, with site elevations between fifty and one hundred fifty metres. It is a three-site observational network, not a gridded national weather product or a common fully observed series for every variable at every hour. Sensor gaps, quality-screening choices and local coastal microclimate are limitations for extrapolation. A reviewer-assessed use is weather forcing or calibration for coastal drainage, PV or building-energy simulations. data-era5-reanalysis is a related atmospheric reference, but no station-to-grid comparison was performed. No weather file or script was downloaded.
